room:house/exits.window.locked: Not yet. First, the key. Grandma knows things.
room:house/look.pantry.house.look-pantry: The pantry cupboard. The sardines live in there.
Locked. I can hear the sardines. (Sardines are silent. I hear them anyway.)
I could stare at it all day. I might.
room:house/look.armchair.house.look-armc: Grandpa's armchair. It eats remotes, coins and socks.
room:house/look.clock.house.look-clock.l: The clock agrees with me: food.
room:house/look.shell: Grandma's shell phone. Talk into it and Grandma answers. From anywhere.
room:house/look.grandma.house.look-grand: Grandma. Keeper of sardines. Loser of keys.
She smells of tea and biscuits. Not Biscuit the cat. The other kind.
room:house/look.biscuit.house.look-biscu: Biscuit. My big brother. Sleeps twenty hours a day.
The other four hours, he naps.
room:house/look.grandpa.house.look-grand: Grandpa. He came home for the sardines. With his armchair.
He is "guarding the pantry". With his eyes closed.
room:house/look.hero.house.look-hero.l-p: Pixel. Smaller than me. Faster than me. Fine.
room:house/look.hero.house.look-hero.l-m: My little brother. Still planning. Always planning.
room:house/look.window.house.look-window: The garden. Grandpa is out there somewhere.
Fresh air, birds, flowers. And Grandpa.
room:house/look.door: The hall. Nothing to eat there. I checked. Twice.
room:house/look.bookshelf.house.look-boo: Books. Not one about sardines. Disappointing.
room:house/look.lamp: A warm lamp. Good for naps. Everything is good for naps.
Got it. It smells like the sea.
room:house/on.house.open-armchair.do.hou: Behind the cushion... a market token!
And Grandpa's remote. I will leave that one. Too much TV.
room:house/on.house.look-armchair.do.hou: Just an armchair now. A comfy one.
room:house/on.house.look-pantry.do.house: Open. An empty tin. A happy cat.
room:house/on.house.use-key-pantry.do[0]: Open! Sardines! Hello, my little friends.
Ha! Two cats, one tin. Share, you two.
room:house/on.house.use-key-pantry.do[1]: Well done, Pixel. Best breakfast ever.
room:house/on.house.open-door.do.house.o: The hall. The vacuum cleaner lives there. Our sworn enemy.
room:house/on.house.take-teacup-2.do.hou: Hot tea and cat paws. No.
room:house/on.house.take-bookshelf.do.ho: A book falls. "Knitting for beginners." I put it back.
room:house/talk.grandma.house.grandma.wh: Grandpa had it last. He is in the garden, fixing the pipes.
New on the map: the garden
Go through the big window. Mind the roses.
Sardines. If we find the key.
Because a certain cat opens cupboards. A certain grey cat.
room:house/talk.grandma.house.grandma.i-: Then what are you waiting for? Open the pantry!
room:house/talk.grandpa.house.grandpa.wh: A cat with a key. I had to see this.
Ask me where the key is, sweetie.
room:house/hints.house.hint-2.lines.hous: Grandpa's armchair eats everything. Look behind the cushion.
Open the armchair, sweetie. Or pull it.
room:house/hints.house.hint-3.lines.hous: Grandpa is in the garden. Go through the big window.
room:house/hints.house.hint-4.lines.hous: Something came out of the water tank, no? Read it, then call Lou.
room:house/hints.house.hint-5.lines.hous: The key is at the market. Open the map.
room:house/hints.house.hint-6.lines.hous: You have the key! Use it on the pantry cupboard.
room:house/onEnter[1].then[0].once.house: Pixel! I beat you home. The armchair is faster than it looks.

room:garden/look.tank.garden.look-tank.l: A big water tank. Full to the top.
Something is at the bottom. Something key-shaped?
room:garden/look.spare_pipe: A spare pipe, lying in the dirt.
room:garden/look.grandpa.garden.look-gra: Grandpa. He carried his armchair outside. For the sun.
He is "fixing the pipes". With his eyes closed.
room:garden/look.gate: The street. Full of dogs. No thanks.
room:garden/look.bench: A bench. Nobody sits on it. Grandpa prefers his armchair.
room:garden/look.gnome.garden.look-gnome: A garden gnome. He has seen things.
room:garden/look.tree: A cherry tree. Birds live up there. Birds! ...Focus, Pixel. Sardines.
room:garden/look.can: A watering can. Empty. Like my food bowl.
room:garden/on.garden.take-spare-pipe.do: A pipe! Grandpa will not miss it. He is asleep.
room:garden/on.garden.use-pipe-tank.do[0: Tap a pipe to turn it. Bring the water to the mushrooms.
That is not a key. That is a sock.
room:garden/on.garden.use-tank.do.garden: The tap is stuck. The water needs another way out. A pipe, maybe?
room:garden/on.garden.use-tank-2.do.gard: Empty-ish. The only treasure was a sock.
room:garden/on.garden.look-sock.do[0].th: A wet sock. With a note inside!
It says: "Borrowed the key to copy it. Lou."
Lou, the neighbour! Call Lou with the shell phone.
room:garden/on.garden.look-sock.do[0].el: A sock. Lou leaves socks everywhere.
room:garden/on.garden.take-sock.do.garde: A wet sock. Cat rule number two: never touch wet things.
room:garden/on.garden.push-gnome.do.gard: He does not move. He has roots.
room:garden/on.garden.use-tree.do.garden: I could climb it. But sardines do not grow on trees.
room:garden/on.garden.take-can.do.garden: Empty. I am not carrying an empty can around.
The key? It fell in the water tank. Plop.
Drain it. But the tap is stuck.
Still stuck? Try a pipe. Pipes are good with water.
Ha! A cat doing plumbing. I love it.
There was no key in the tank!
No? Only a sock? Read the sock. Socks always have something to say.
It wanted some sun. Armchairs need vitamins too.
Yes. With my eyes closed. I am an expert.
room:garden/hints.garden.hint.lines.gard: There is a spare pipe on the ground. Take it, sweetie.
room:garden/hints.garden.hint-2.lines.ga: Use the pipe on the water tank.
room:garden/hints.garden.hint-3.lines.ga: Something came out of the tank. Look at it.
room:garden/hints.garden.hint-4.lines.ga: Talk into my shell phone and call Lou.
room:garden/hints.garden.hint-5.lines.ga: Lou is at the market. Open the map.
room:garden/hints.garden.hint-6.lines.ga: Come home with that key, sweetie!
room:garden/onEnter[0].once.garden.enter: Pixel! Did you come to help me fix the pipes?
I came for a key. And sardines.

room:market/look.stall: Spices, teapots, a lantern. No sardines. What kind of market is this?
room:market/look.lantern: The lantern Lou wants. Shiny. Not edible.
room:market/look.bouquet: My bouquet! Freshly picked. By me. With paws.
room:market/look.neighbor.market.look-ne: Lou, the neighbour. Fixes everything. Borrows everything.
Lou smells of oil and socks.
room:market/look.seller.market.look-sell: The seller. Big moustache. Bigger smile.
He keeps looking at the flowers. Suspicious.
room:market/look.far_stalls.market.look-: More stalls, further down. Also no sardines.
A whole market and not one fish.
room:market/look.blue_door: A big blue door. Locked. Everything is locked today.
room:market/on.market.look-alley.do.mark: The alley goes on and on. Like Biscuit's naps. The map is that way.
A token? Today I only take flowers. For... reasons.
Pick the right three flowers from my bucket, and the token will do.
The seller wants a red flower with a black heart.
Now a big yellow one that looks at the sun.
Last one: purple, and it smells like soap.
Ouch! A nettle. Not romantic at all.
Beautiful! I put it on the stall for you.
room:market/on.market.take-bouquet.do.ma: For the seller. Not for eating. Sadly.
room:market/on.market.give-bouquet-selle: For me? ...Oh no. Today is my wedding anniversary!
I forgot! You saved me, little cat.
The key? I hid it under my oranges. Nobody steals oranges.
The key? Inside the lantern. Lou wants it, so I keep it safe.
Here: the key. The lantern is paid.
room:market/on.market.take-key-oranges.d: Under the oranges: the key! It smells of oranges now.
room:market/on.market.take-key-lantern.d: Inside the lantern: the key! Lou gets his lantern, I get my key.
room:market/on.market.take-lantern.do.ma: Paws off! That lantern is sold. Almost.
room:market/on.market.take-oranges.do.ma: Oranges are not sardines. Nice try, oranges.
room:market/talk.neighbor.market.neighbo: Ah. I left it with the seller. A deposit for that lantern.
Pay for the lantern and the key is yours.
That is MY key! Well, Grandma's.
Technically, it is his now. Deposits are serious business.
He loves tokens. And flowers. Mostly flowers today.
Why did you take the key?
To make a copy. In case Grandma loses it.
For my garage. I fix things at night. Like a bat with a wrench.
room:market/talk.seller.market.seller.ca: The key is Lou's deposit. Pay for the lantern, and it is yours.
Tokens are fine. Flowers are better. Today, flowers are much better.
room:market/talk.seller.market.seller.wh: No reason. Definitely no reason. What day is it?
room:market/hints.market.hint.lines.mark: Talk to Lou about the key, sweetie.
room:market/hints.market.hint-2.lines.ma: Did you search Grandpa's armchair at home? It eats tokens.
room:market/hints.market.hint-3.lines.ma: Give your market token to the seller.
room:market/hints.market.hint-4.lines.ma: Your bouquet is on the stall. Take it.
room:market/hints.market.hint-key-spot.l: The seller hid the key on his stall. Ask him again, or look under things.
room:market/hints.market.hint-5.lines.ma: Give the bouquet to the seller.
room:market/hints.market.hint-6.lines.ma: You have the key! Come home and open the pantry.
item:shell_phone/look.item.shell-phone.l: Grandma's shell phone. Talk into it and Grandma answers.
It smells like the sea. And a bit like Grandma.
Still a shell. Still a phone.
If I hold it to my ear, I hear the ocean. And Grandma knitting.
item:token/look: A market token with a big star. Worth one go at something.
item:pipe/look: A piece of pipe. Water goes in, water goes out. Like me with milk.
item:bouquet/look.item.bouquet.l-a-prett: A pretty bouquet. Picked with paws.
item:key/look: The pantry key! It jingles like a tin of sardines.
char:grandma/refuse: Keep it, fluffball. You will need it.
char:grandpa/refuse: Not now, Pixel. I am busy. Resting.
char:neighbor/refuse: Thanks, but my pockets are full. Of other people's things.

rules/fallbacks.open.fallback.open.l-it-: It does not open. I pushed it with my nose.
rules/fallbacks.close.fallback.close.l-a: Already closed. Like my eyes, most of the day.

rules/fallbacks.take.fallback.take.l-i-w: I will leave it there. For now.

rules/fallbacks.push.fallback.push.l-it-: It does not move. I need more breakfast.
rules/fallbacks.pull.fallback.pull.l-i-p: I pull. It stays. We are even.
rules/fallbacks.use2.fallback.use2.l-the: These do not go together. Like cats and baths.

rules/kinds.kind.push-cat.say: Never push a sleeping cat. Cat law, article two.

rules/kinds.kind.push-person.say: Pushing people around? Not my style. I am a nice cat.
Had. I am at the market. Come and get it!
Hurry up, it is busy here. Bye!
